facts.fact: 中情局人事处长兼副局长 BLUEBELL 在七楼办公桌后表示：没有生日蛋糕他就不签字批准。
facts.anchor: “If there ain’t no birthday cake,” said the Chief of Human Resources/Associate Deputy Director of the United States Central Intelligence Agency from behind his massive Seventh Floor desk, “I ain’t signin’ off on it.”

facts.fact: 驻外归来的站长告诉 BLUEBELL，距会议只剩不到五十小时，来不及把定制生日蛋糕运到前进作战基地。
facts.anchor: We have less than fifty hours to go.

facts.fact: BLUEBELL 命令派直升机送蛋糕，并要求让约旦人安排给该特工唱《生日快乐》。
facts.anchor: “Send a dang helicopter. It’s the agent’s birthday, and he needs to feel welcome and at home.

facts.fact: MUCHADOO 进门时还没减掉他一直想减的那九十七磅，因此有点喘。
facts.anchor: having not yet shed those ninety-seven pounds he’d been meaning to lose.

facts.fact: 叙述交代 BLUEBELL 的花名（Funny Name）是 Calvin A. BLUEBELL。
facts.anchor: whose Funny Name was Calvin A. BLUEBELL.

facts.fact: ARISTOTLE 转述：负责护送特工进场的保护小组再次请求在首次会面前对他多做审查。
facts.anchor: The protective detail bringing the agent in has put in another request to vet him a little more before the first meeting.

facts.fact: MUCHADOO 转述 Wacker 的话：一千名 NOC 都会对外称自己是“转型人力资源顾问”。
facts.anchor: He said all one thousand NOCs will tell people they work as Transformational Human Resources consultants.

facts.fact: MUCHADOO 说今晚有 Blacks In Government Roundtable，但他要跳过，因为议程是他写的。
facts.anchor: There’s a Blacks In Government Roundtable tonight, but I’m going to skip it. I wrote the agenda.
